note: Allowlisted globs per run class. '*' stays inside one folder and '**' crosses folders. The code deny-list in collect.py always wins.

connected-harness.description: Connected Boutique walkthrough: two recoveries, crash reconciliation and an unnecessary rollback refused

agent.description: Connected Boutique with the live RCA agent and Ollama Recovery Planner

guard-rejection.description: Healthy service, unnecessary rollback proposed; Guard must refuse with zero Executor writes

shipping-lab.description: Single-service Boutique lab with operator-authored proposals

provider-recovery.description: Connected Boutique driven by a configured provider script

ui-session.description: Browser-controlled session; records whether a scenario was ever triggered

packaged.description: Packaged runner image driving the Boutique walkthrough

scenario-pair.description: Two simultaneous catalog faults on the connected Boutique (P4.05, scripts/test_boutique_live.py --connected --pair): the pair result, ShopOutcome, injection, chaos record and attribution, and per target its proposals, Guard decisions, dependency findings, executions, outcomes and scenario score; never the Executor worker configuration, baselines or databases

chaos-batch.description: Chaos Mesh fault batch: injection, cleanup and recovery windows; no Sentinel action

security-lab.description: Protected Boutique security lab: mTLS gateway, bypass and outage probes

observer-acceptance.description: Live Observer acceptance on Boutique: detection and duplicate suppression

executor-wedge.description: Live Executor wedge harness: one scenario in a disposable namespace; the first action must resolve without a write, a second proposal is then admitted

distributed-scenario.description: One experiments/distributed/run_scenarios.py run: Coordinator and workers as separate processes on one host, against the file-backed test cluster (file mode) or a kind lab Deployment (kind mode); kind-wrapper.json and trace-waterfall.txt are operator records attached from beside the run folder

kind-lab-session.description: Operator records of one kind-mode lab session: bundle preparation and its RBAC checks, the Verifier policy, a restore check, the run index and lab-state snapshots; no scenario results (those are distributed-scenario bundles)

executor-admission.description: Live check of the Executor admission policy (scripts/validation/test_executor_admission_live.py) in a disposable namespace with a restricted executor token

worker-container.description: A worker image run as a container against a Coordinator on the host: orchestrator events, health and /readyz samples, container logs and Docker state, and the Planner's saved report

rcaeval.description: One method on one split of the pre-registered RCAEval sample (scripts/evaluation/rcaeval_run.py); scores and predictions only, never telemetry or trajectories

distributed-acceptance.description: Four-node kind lab sentinel-dist (experiments/distributed/kind_acceptance.py): per-run summaries, timelines, sanitised API server audit extracts, Coordinator records and versions; never databases, logs, keys or certificates
